profile.summary: LeadersUp is a nonprofit that works to connect young adults of color to careers and to change education, workforce and economic systems. It does research, develops solutions and builds networks of employers and partners. It works in the Bay Area, Chicago and Greater Los Angeles.

review.notes: Identity is plausible (Los Angeles 501(c)(3) LeadersUp, EIN 46-2606773, career-pathways mission fits Adult and Career Education), and the contact and legal fields check out. However, the summary states it works in the Bay Area, Chicago and Greater Los Angeles and builds networks of employers; the cited pages do not say this (the homepage does not mention the Bay Area), and the candidate admits the regional claim is uncited, so the summary is not supported.
